acceptedAnswer.text: It answers from the information you supply and is built to say it does not know rather than fill the gap. That is a deliberate trade: fewer confident answers, no invented ones.

mainEntity.name: What happens to conversations it cannot finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: They are captured with the visitor’s details and passed to you. An unanswered question you can see is far more useful than a visitor who quietly left.
Yes, and it is designed for it — most of these conversations happen on a phone, so the widget is built for a thumb rather than shrunk from desktop.

mainEntity.name: How much work is it for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: The writing is the work. Most of it already exists in your inbox as answers you have typed a hundred times.
